features.title: Replay Any Day, Minute by Minute
features.description: Pick a date. Every stop, every route, every minute — laid out in a single glance. The granular timeline view Google quietly killed.

features.title: Answer "Where Was I?" Instantly
features.description: Type a date. See exactly where you were, what route you took, how long you stayed. Every trip, commute, and detour — searchable forever.

features.title: Relive Any Trip in Detail
features.description: Pick a date range. Dawarich builds the map, calculates the distance, traces the route. Add photos and it becomes a travel journal.

features.title: See Your Life in Numbers
features.description: How many countries. How many kilometers. Your most-visited city. Monthly patterns you never noticed. Share your stats with a single link.

features.title: Track Your World Progress
features.description: Watch countries light up as you visit them. See the gaps. Plan what's next.

features.title: Understand Your Patterns
features.description: Are you traveling less than last year? Spending more time in one city? Dawarich spots trends you'd never notice on your own.

title: Everything Google Timeline Should Have Been
subtitle: All the features you loved, none of the privacy trade-offs.
